definitions: To have similar ideas and opinions to someone else.
To understand each other well because you share similar views or ways of thinking.
examples: It's great working with her; we're always on the same wavelength.
They finished each other's sentences, clearly on the same wavelength.
After years of friendship, they were definitely on the same wavelength.
lemma: to be on the same wavelength
source: to be on the same wavelength
